title: Which Way Do You Turn on Ice?
hook: Which way do you steer when sliding?

script.narration: Which way do you steer when sliding?
script.visual_search: car sliding on icy road dashcam

script.narration: If your rear wheels lose traction and slide to the left, most drivers panic and steer right. That causes a dangerous spin. You must always steer directly into the slide.
Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Did you know this rule? Comment yes or no, and remember

description: Test your driving knowledge with this quick mini quiz on how to safely recover when your car loses traction on ice or wet roads. Essential driving tips and tricks for new drivers.
why_it_will_work: Leverages the mini-quiz format to drive high viewer engagement and retention, tapping into practical vehicle control topics.
